AI · Consensus Engine

Quorum

One question. A council of models. A single, trusted answer.

Single LLMs are confidently wrong. Quorum convenes a council of models, clusters their answers by meaning, measures agreement, and surfaces the most reliable response — making disagreement visible instead of hiding it behind one model's confidence.
